reference_sql:
SELECT category_id, product_id, unit_cost_eur,
       ROUND(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY category_id ORDER BY unit_cost_eur), 3) AS cost_pct_rank
FROM products
WHERE category_id BETWEEN 1 AND 6
alternatives:
SELECT p.category_id, p.product_id, p.unit_cost_eur,
       ROUND(COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products p2 WHERE p2.category_id = p.category_id AND p2.unit_cost_eur < p.unit_cost_eur) * 1.0
             / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products p3 WHERE p3.category_id = p.category_id) - 1, 0), 0), 3) AS cost_pct_rank
FROM products p
WHERE p.category_id BETWEEN 1 AND 6

SELECT category_id, product_id, unit_cost_eur,
       ROUND((RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY category_id ORDER BY unit_cost_eur) - 1) * 1.0
             / (COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY category_id) - 1), 3) AS cost_pct_rank
FROM products
WHERE category_id BETWEEN 1 AND 6
